about: Research drone (0.99 kg X quad, 5 in props) as SIH quadx, from research/research_drone_params.yaml (P8): mass A (firmware MASS_KG, not weighed), inertia/arm/thrust/motor tau D. Q_MAX left at the SIH default (the yaw moment fit is flagged unchecked). PX4 gains at quadx defaults (untuned). IMU noise SIH_GYR_STD/SIH_ACC_STD calibrated 2026-11-04 to the real drone (gyro 0.022-0.024 rad/s measured, real 0.020-0.024; P11 batch 4). Delay stays per scenario (SIH_ACT_DLY).
